name: X7V1
direction: ROM to receiver through stock video; no return channel
bit_order: row-major cells, byte most significant bit first; 1 black, 0 white
border: outermost cells black iff (x+y)%2==0; remaining non-payload ring white
manifest_payload: ASCII safe 8.3 basename, 1..12 bytes, no NUL; preserved as display/export name, never used as internal storage path
data_payload: 120 bytes except exact final remainder; zero-based block; empty files have no data blocks
identity: manifest filename + file size + source CRC; data associated by size + source CRC, assuming one selected file broadcasts at a time; not collision-proof session identity
repetition: manifest before each pass and every 32 data blocks; repeat all blocks until user stops
receiver: Latch first valid manifest; reject conflicting manifest; ignore data before manifest or with different size/CRC. Reject invalid frame CRC or invalid layout. Accept out-of-order blocks; identical duplicates ignored, conflicting duplicates fail. Verify complete coverage, exact file length and CRC by reading staged file before exposing verified output. No checksum collision immunity or source save validity guarantee.
